top_signals.title: Once-Hot AI Trade Leaves Korean Stocks Struggling for Buyers
top_signals.summary: South Korea spent much of this year as a poster child of the scorching global AI trade. Now, by almost every measure, the $4.3 trillion stock market is rapidly losing relevance with investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Kalshi is investigating bets on Trump’s press secretary pick placed before announcement: WSJ
top_signals.summary: Three bets totaling about $173 were placed before news outlets reported Zacharia's pick and are expected to pay out roughly $9,600 combined.
